I am the second oldest of 5 siblings. We are 21 M 19F (me) 16F, 13M 9F. Every year since my youngest sister was born we have been doing funny photo shoots for my mom’s birthday. We put the photos into a giant card and all go out shopping for her birthday present. This has become a tradition that has gotten better and better over the years. From the outside looking in am I (and my brother I guess) being an A-hole? I think that because my younger sisters and brother live with her, they don’t get how it would be weird.
